function: Excluded (function): learned methods are CNN wideband spectrum sensing trained by FL with digital FedAvg aggregation (p. 8), and DDQN sub-channel allocation of detected holes (p. 15).
notes: Excluded, function. (i) The main learned model is a CNN that detects spectrum holes from I/Q samples (p. 1: "we propose a multi-label classification problem for wideband spectrum sensing"), i.e. spectrum sensing, trained with FL whose server aggregates weights digitally (p. 8, Algorithm 1: "Aggregate local model weights at the server per Eq. (15)"), with no over-the-air computation, so outside area 7. (ii) The DDQN only picks a sub-channel among the detected holes for each UAV (p. 15: "the Q-learning methods choose the best sub-channel to allocate to a UAV"), spectrum access and scheduling rather than power or beam control, using "existing RL algorithms" (p. 16). Borderline for the reviewer: if (ii) is read as resource allocation of an aerial link (area 6), the work would pass this check.
